sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.61 Dev

  • Removed codebase languages distribution bar: Completely removed the languages distribution bar from the Settings General tab based on user feedback.

v1.3.60 Dev

  • Reverted CSS units from rem to px: Restored layout and typography dimensions back to px inside builder-panel.js, resolving the 1.6x oversized user interface in WordPress Admin where the root font-size is 16px.
  • Fixed Settings tab squishing: Converted settings tabs container to use a flexbox layout, fully restoring visibility to General, Mimam's Bar, CSS Studio, and Modules tabs.
  • Relocated codebase languages bar: Moved the GitHub-style languages distribution bar from the Sync sub-panel to the General Settings tab.
  • Updated Notion documentation: Synchronized release notes and update checks.

v1.3.59 Dev

  • Enhanced Snapshot UI: Redesigned snapshot cards with proper visual buttons, clear headers, restorable tags, and readable metadata (Snapshot numbers, modified counts, exact timestamp).
  • Plugin-Wide CSS Variable System: Refactored styling to use a centralized variables system, replacing static hardcoded values. Configured a 10px = 1rem grid rhythm with rem-based spacing and sizing, and enforced an 11px (1.1rem) minimum text size boundary.
  • Languages Distribution: Added a GitHub-style languages distribution bar (PHP 78.5%, JS 18.2%, CSS 3.3%) to the builder settings panel.
  • Always-Visible Database Cleanup: Database cleanup button is now always accessible in the WordPress Database settings section.
  • Import Isolation Fix: Fixed palette/category isolation when importing files or Figma packages, preventing AT/CF name leakage.

v1.3.58 Dev

  • Decoded Metadata Warnings: Custom snapshot titles and descriptions render properly even when snapshot is flagged as Unavailable with warnings.
  • Recovery Modal: Converted inline recovery snapshot form to a clean dialog modal shown only on New Snapshot click.
  • Stale Generator Cleanup: Orphaned generator rows referencing deleted or non-base variables are automatically removed on database cleanup.
  • Isolated Category/Palette Import: Imports from Figma or files are isolated inside source-named categories/color palettes rather than fallback AT/CF options.
